title: Turn off the WinINET proxy for the current user
description: Sets ProxyEnable to 0 under the documented HKCU Internet Settings key: the configured WinINET proxy stops being used by the current user. ProxyServer, AutoConfigURL and ProxyOverride are deliberately kept in place (the mode=off contract of the network.proxy op), so re-enabling or undo restores the exact previous triple. Machines behind a corporate proxy lose connectivity while this feature is applied - do not use it there. The probe pins ProxyEnable and leaves the server values unverified with the documented <any> sentinel.
